item.title: Dense Fog Advisory issued by National Weather Service
item.description: BINGHAMTON, NY (WUTR/WFXV/WPNY) – The National Weather Service Office in Binghamton has issued a Dense Fog Advisory for portions of Central New York, including Oneida, Herkimer, Otsego and Madison Counties. item.title: Hawkeyes earn Class C boys' basketball top seed
item.description: The high school boys' basketball season has come to an end, and 27 local teams will be moving on to the Section III Boys' Basketball Tournament after the seeding announcement on Wednesday, February 18.

item.title: Jugglers, Maroon Knights earn top seeds in girls' basketball sectionals
item.description: The high school girls' basketball season has come to an end, and 19 local teams will be moving on to the Section III Tournament after the seeding announcement on Wednesday, February 18.

item.title: Federal government releases funds Gateway Tunnel after court order
item.description: The federal government released $237 million in frozen funds to New York and New Jersey for the Gateway Tunnel project, allowing work to resume after a funding freeze had halted construction and laid off 1,000 union workers.

item.title: ICE retracts claim of purchasing Orange County facility for new immigration detention center
item.description: ICE retracted its claim of purchasing an Orange County warehouse to repurpose as a detention center, but defended its immigration enforcement operations and released details of several undocumented people recently arrested in New York.

item.title: Essential Health to End for Many New Yorkers
item.description: New York's affordable healthcare plan is in jeopardy. Many New Yorkers could lose their Essential Plan healthcare coverage in July. H.R. 1, the Big Beautiful Bill, as President Trump calls it, cut existing Obamacare funding for states.
